prompt: Segment the white-matter hyperintensities (WMH) in the FLAIR image of subject Amsterdam/GE3T/100 (WMH Segmentation Challenge 2017), producing a binary WMH mask in native FLAIR space. The data is on DataverseNL (DOI 10.34894/AECRSD), NOT OpenNeuro — fetch the FLAIR with the provided download command (open Dataverse access API, no login required).
reference: Primary expert WMH mask (observers O1/O2), WMH Challenge 2017, native FLAIR space.
threshold_basis: DATA-DERIVED from inter-rater agreement: observers O3, O4 scored vs the primary (O1/O2) set the envelope. WMH = many small foci, so lesion-wise F1 is weighted equally with Dice.
